The '''Wilderness Agility Course''' is a training area located deep in the [[Wilderness]], requiring level 52 [[Agility]]{{Boostable|yes}} to enter, and 49 Agility{{Boostable|yes}} to complete the first obstacle inside. '''{{Colour|Red|The entire course is dangerous}}''', taking place in a [[singles-plus combat]] area that allows [[player killers]] to attack at any time, '''even if you are already in combat with a monster'''.

The course can be completed either risk-free, or with paid access to the [[agility dispenser]]. Tagging the dispenser after completing a lap rewards one [[Wilderness agility ticket]], redeemable for Agility experience, and if the reward fee is paid it also dispenses loot after each lap. The fee is 150,000 coins, which is lost '''every time''' a player dies or leaves the course, but is not removed if they log out and remain within the course. '''This money must be deposited from a player's inventory''', unlike other Wilderness fees which can be withdrawn from a bank. On [[Bounty Hunter]] worlds, this fee must be paid in order to ''enter'' the course. It can be paid at the entrance gate, or at the dispenser on another world before [[World switching|hopping worlds]].

A counter tracks how many consecutive laps have been completed; a higher number of laps increases the average value of dispenser rewards, in discrete intervals. Even though the coins are not lost when logging out inside the course, doing so will remove 10 laps from the reward lap counter. Lastly, the player '''must''' have an open [[looting bag]] in their inventory to obtain loot. Looting bags '''cannot''' be destroyed within the course.

The agility dispenser restores [[run energy]] whenever it's tagged, regardless of whether or not players have completed a lap or paid the fee. As such, players who intend to pay the opt-in fee should bring combat equipment to protect from the [[skeletons]] and potential player-killers, rather than [[energy-restoring items]] or [[weight-reducing clothing]]. 

This course does not reward [[Marks of Grace]].

Note that the level 52 [[Agility]] requirement is only needed to enter the gates; the level requirement of the obstacles is level 49. Therefore it is possible to use a [[temporary skill boost]] to access the course starting at level 47, giving far superior rates to other courses available to the same level.

==Mechanics==
If all obstacles are passed, in the correct order, a substantial chunk of "bonus" experience is rewarded at the end of the lap. Players who skip obstacles or do not successfully complete obstacles they fail will '''not''' receive any bonus experience, dramatically reducing experience rates.  Failing will result in damage, detailed below. Players with higher Agility have a higher success rate at passing the obstacles; however, even at level 99, it is still possible to fail an obstacle. 

In addition to the risk of [[player-killers]], there are multiple level 18 and 25 [[skeleton]]s roaming the course and underground respectively that will attack any player near them. For this reason, a source of cheap food (such as [[wines]]) can be useful to help restore lost [[health]].

===Dispenser rewards===
{{Main|Agility dispenser}}
Players who pay the 150,000 coin fee will gain access to the [[Agility dispenser|dispenser]], which will reward them with items directly into an open looting bag. After each lap, the dispenser provides both noted [[Alchemy spells|alchables]] and noted [[Blighted|blighted items]], in addition to one unnoted blighted item if players have empty inventory slots. Additionally, there is a 1 in 40 chance per lap to receive a [[medium clue scroll]]; the [[ring of wealth (i)]] will increase this to 1 in 20. If the player's inventory is full, the clue scroll will be dropped to the ground.

The loot given each lap increases in value the more laps are accumulated. The laps only start counting from the moment the 150,000 GP are paid. Keep note, that if the player logs out, 10 laps will be deducted from their total lap count. Logging out has no effect on the 150,000 GP.

== Money making ==
{{Mmgsection|Wilderness Agility Course}}

==Experience rates==
The course rewards 571.4 Agility [[experience]] per completed lap, with five obstacles needing to be passed for completion. Assuming an average of 45 seconds per lap, players can expect a base experience of 40,000-45,000 experience per hour depending on concentration and Agility level, and up to 18,400 bonus experience assuming players play for at least 2 hours and turn in all their [[Wilderness agility ticket|Agility tickets]] at once. This requires players to complete <u>all</u> obstacles, as skipping an obstacle will not award the lap bonus at the end, which makes up the bulk of the experience per lap. Due to the success rate of the obstacles, the experience rates scale with the player's Agility level. Theoretically, a maximum of 89 laps could be completed per hour (67 [[RuneScape clock|tick]]s per lap), resulting in 50,800 Agility experience per hour. However, due to obstacles being failable even at level 99 Agility, expect to achieve a maximum of around 47,500 Agility experience per hour at higher Agility levels.

Players can generally assume a lap time of 45 seconds. Bank time is assumed to be 2 minutes, 10 seconds, and done by leaving the course, running through the gate to the Wilderness obelisk, traveling to the 13-Wilderness option (Ferox Enclave), using the bank, and then returning with an [[Ice plateau teleport (tablet)|Ice Plateau tablet]].

===Ticket bonuses===
Players can redeem [[Wilderness agility ticket|Wilderness agility tickets]] for experience, which are earned after each lap. The more tickets turned in at once, the greater the bonus per ticket. Players can exit the agility course with their tickets and store them in the bank.

Tickets are unaffected by logging out or leaving the agility course. They are also always kept on death as they are untradeable, meaning that there is little reason to not redeem tickets in batches of 101+ as so to gain the most experience from them.
